title: Procurement Request and Purchase Order Procedure
content: All procurement requests must be submitted through the HIS Supply Chain Module by the requesting department head; verbal or informal procurement requests are not accepted. The request must include: item description, specifications, quantity, clinical or operational justification, required-by date, and budget code. Requests below $1,000 are approved by the Department Head; $1,000–$5,000 require Supply Chain Manager approval; amounts above $5,000 require Finance Director sign-off and a minimum of three competitive quotations. Emergency procurement (for patient safety-critical items) may be verbally authorized by the Operations Manager and must be formally documented within 4 hours. All approved purchase orders must be issued on hospital letterhead or through the HIS; no verbal orders to vendors are permitted. Goods received must be inspected against the purchase order for quantity, specifications, and expiry dates before acceptance; discrepancies must be notified to the vendor and Supply Chain Manager within 24 hours.
